# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest version deployed on [quran.com](https://quran.com) (the `production` branch) is
supported with security updates. Tagged releases (e.g. `v0.0.12`) are not separately patched; if a
fix is needed, it lands on `production`.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please **do not** open a public GitHub
issue.

[Private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
is not yet enabled on this repository. Until it is, please report vulnerabilities directly to a
maintainer:

1. Open a new issue titled `Security: request for private contact` with **no vulnerability details**
   in the body, just a note that you have a security report to share privately.
2. A maintainer will respond on that issue to arrange a private channel (e.g. email or the
   [Quran.com Discord](https://discord.gg/SpEeJ5bWEQ)) for the actual report.

Once private vulnerability reporting is enabled for this repository, this document will be updated
to point directly to the Security tab's "Report a vulnerability" flow instead.

When reporting, please include as much detail as possible: steps to reproduce, affected versions,
and potential impact.

A maintainer will acknowledge your report and start triage. Response times are best-effort, as this
is not a project with a contracted security SLA.
